name: Afghan Hospitality Experience
overview: Experience Afghan hospitality through family-style meals, tea houses, local markets, traditional clothing, and cultural interactions in Kabul.

name: Afghan Food and Culture Journey
overview: Explore Afghanistan through its cuisine, markets, regional specialties, tea culture, traditional dining, and local hospitality.

name: Kabul Cultural Discovery
overview: Discover Kabul's history, architecture, museums, bazaars, gardens, and cultural landmarks while experiencing daily life in the capital.

name: Buzkashi Experience
overview: Witness Afghanistan's national sport and learn about the traditions, history, horses, and culture surrounding Buzkashi.

name: Herat Arts and Architecture
overview: Explore Herat's mosques, citadel, minarets, calligraphy, tilework, artisans, and rich Timurid heritage.

name: Mazar Spiritual and Silk Road Heritage
overview: Discover Balkh and Mazar-e-Sharif through spiritual sites, Silk Road history, architecture, and local traditions.

name: Traditional Afghan Clothing and Crafts
overview: Learn about traditional Afghan dress, tailoring, embroidery, jewelry, textiles, and regional craftsmanship.

name: Tea Houses Bazaars and Daily Life
overview: Experience traditional tea houses, local markets, craftsmen, street food, and everyday life in Afghanistan.

name: Rural Village Life Experience
overview: Spend time in rural communities learning about farming, hospitality, local traditions, and village life.

name: Kandahar Pomegranate Harvest Experience
overview: Seasonal journey focused on Kandahar's famous pomegranates, orchards, agriculture, and local traditions.

name: Afghan Tea and Chai Culture
overview: Explore the role of tea in Afghan society through traditional tea houses, hospitality customs, and regional tea traditions.

name: Istalif Pottery and Artisan Traditions
overview: Visit Istalif's pottery workshops and learn about centuries-old ceramic traditions and artisan culture.
